name: differential-review
description: Security review of a change set (GitHub PR, commit range, single commit, branch or patch file): ranks changed files by risk, traces deleted checks to the commit that added them to catch regressions, counts dependents, raises risk for untested logic, builds attacker scenarios for every high-risk hunk, and writes the report to $TMPDIR. Works on any git host; GitHub PRs are read with gh when it is available.
